healthAuthorities.name: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (Sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö, STM)
healthAuthorities.description: Steers the 2023 wellbeing services county reform jointly with the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of the Interior. Counties are centrally funded and cannot (yet) levy taxes.

healthAuthorities.name: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
healthAuthorities.description: National statistics and research institute for health and welfare; publishes hospital activity/productivity statistics.

healthAuthorities.name: Kanta Services (Kela)
healthAuthorities.description: National digital-health data-exchange infrastructure operated by Kela: e-prescription, OmaKanta patient portal, national e-archive that every regional CPIS/EHR integrates into.

healthAuthorities.name: City of Helsinki - Social Services, Health Care and Rescue Services Division
healthAuthorities.description: Organizes its own primary/social care and rescue services outside the wellbeing-county structure (constitutional exception for the capital); specialised hospital care via HUS Group. Executive Director Juha Jolkkonen.

healthAuthorities.name: Vantaa and Kerava Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Regional Director Timo Aronkytö. Organizes primary/social care for Vantaa and Kerava; specialised hospital care via HUS Group (Peijas Hospital). Apotti (Epic) owner, 15.32% share.

healthAuthorities.name: Central Uusimaa Wellbeing Services County (Keusote)
healthAuthorities.description: Regional Director Raija Kontio. Six municipalities (Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Mäntsälä, Nurmijärvi, Pornainen, Tuusula), ~200,000 residents. Formally exited Apotti 2 May 2024 (~EUR 11m exit cost); selected CGI OMNI360 (~EUR 10m).

healthAuthorities.name: Western Uusimaa Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Regional Director Sanna Svahn. 10 municipalities incl. Espoo, Lohja, Kirkkonummi, Kauniainen. Formally exited Apotti 2 May 2024 (~EUR 17m exit cost); selected Tietoevry Lifecare jointly with Eastern Uusimaa (~EUR 11.3m ex-VAT).

healthAuthorities.name: Eastern Uusimaa Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Regional Director Max Lönnqvist. 7 municipalities (Askola, Lapinjärvi, Loviisa, Myrskylä, Porvoo, Pukkila, Sipoo), HQ Porvoo. Formally exited Apotti 2 May 2024 (~EUR 5m exit cost); selected Tietoevry Lifecare jointly with Western Uusimaa (~EUR 4.3m ex-VAT), phased go-live Mar/May/Aug 2026.

healthAuthorities.name: HUS Group (Hospital District of Helsinki and Uusimaa)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Matti Bergendahl. Specialised-care joint authority owned by Helsinki + the four other Uusimaa wellbeing counties. 2.2m population served, 21 hospitals, 26,500 staff. Largest Apotti (Epic) owner, 46.33% share; runs Apotti at Meilahti, Toolo, New Children's, Women's, Jorvi, Peijas, Hyvinkaa, Lohja, Porvoo and Raasepori even where the host county has exited Apotti for its own primary/social care. Helsinki/HUS/Vantaa-Kerava commissioned a BearingPoint study (reported Mar 2026) on whether to replace Apotti; exploratory only, no decision.

healthAuthorities.name: Southwest Finland Wellbeing Services County (Varha)
healthAuthorities.description: Director Tarmo Martikainen. ~498,000 residents, 27 municipalities. CGI OMNI360, replacing legacy Uranus; primary care live, Tyks (specialist care) targeted Dec 2026.

healthAuthorities.name: Satakunta Wellbeing Services County (Satasote)
healthAuthorities.description: Director Tero Mäkiranta. Tietoevry Lifecare, full region-wide unification completed 10 May 2025 (previously fragmented: Lifecare + 3x Pegasos + 2 dental systems).

healthAuthorities.name: Kanta-Häme Wellbeing Services County (Oma Häme)
healthAuthorities.description: Director Olli Naukkarinen. Tietoevry Lifecare, primary and specialised care systems unified 1 Jan 2025.

healthAuthorities.name: Pirkanmaa Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Acting CEO Mika Kontio (from 1 Jan 2026; prior directors Marina Erhola, then Juhani Sand). CGI OMNI360, selected jointly with North Savo (4 Apr 2024), retiring legacy Lifecare + Mediatri. Primary care live; Tays (specialised care) go-live delayed.

healthAuthorities.name: Päijät-Häme Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: CEO unconfirmed at primary-source level (paijatha.fi blocked repeated fetches). EHR vendor not independently confirmed at primary-source level; recurring 'asiakas- ja potilastietojärjestelmä' maintenance-window notices are consistent with Lifecare (per secondary-source roundup, live since Jan 2023) but this needs a direct primary-source check before being treated as fully confirmed.

healthAuthorities.name: Kymenlaakso Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Kari Hakari (transition from Harri Hagman, election 16 Jun 2026 — likely but not conclusively confirmed post-vote). TerveysLifecare + SosiaaliLifecare confirmed via official document-publicity description; first Finnish county on the newest Lifecare version (24 Sep 2023).

healthAuthorities.name: South Karelia Wellbeing Services County (Eksote)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Sally Leskinen. ~125,000 residents, 9 municipalities. terveysLifecare confirmed via official source; social services mixed Effica/Lifecare. Entered formal state financial-oversight 'arviointimenettely' in 2026 — relevant to IT-investment capacity/timing.

healthAuthorities.name: South Savo Wellbeing Services County (Eloisa)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Santeri Seppälä. ~130,000 residents, 11 municipalities. Tietoevry Lifecare patient system already live; Oct 2025 decision (joint with North Karelia) added Lifecare client/social system, migration through 2026.

healthAuthorities.name: North Savo Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Marko Korhonen. CGI OMNI360, selected jointly with Pirkanmaa (4 Apr 2024) via Istekki. Primary care live; KYS (specialised care) go-live delayed to autumn 2026, whole-county target Oct 2026.

healthAuthorities.name: North Karelia Wellbeing Services County (Siun sote)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Kirsi Leivonen. ~166,400 inhabitants, 13 municipalities. Tietoevry Lifecare selected Oct 2025 jointly with South Savo. NOT YET LIVE: phased rollout social services Nov 2026, dental spring 2027, primary/home-care/specialised-care (hospital) autumn 2027, full completion end 2027.

healthAuthorities.name: Central Finland Wellbeing Services County (Hyvaks)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Piia Vuorela (from 22 Apr 2026). Tietoevry Lifecare, live since spring 2024 (primary, specialist, dental), extended to a 9-municipality northern sub-region autumn 2024, replacing Pegasos/Mediatri/WinHit.

healthAuthorities.name: South Ostrobothnia Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Director Tero Järvinen. Tietoevry Lifecare, region-wide since ~2014 per trade-press roundup (exact date needs primary-source confirmation) — one of the earliest Finnish Lifecare deployments.

healthAuthorities.name: Ostrobothnia Wellbeing Services County (Pohjanmaa)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Marina Kinnunen. Tietoevry Lifecare selected via competitive dialogue 2023 (vs CGI, Mediconsult); go-live began 6 Oct 2024, region-wide by spring 2025, replacing 6 legacy systems. Fire/rescue explicitly excluded. Finland's only fully bilingual (FI/SV) hospital region.

healthAuthorities.name: Central Ostrobothnia Wellbeing Services County (Soite)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Mikko Komulainen. 8 municipalities incl. Kokkola. Tietoevry Lifecare, region-wide since ~2017 per trade-press roundup (exact date needs primary-source confirmation).

healthAuthorities.name: North Ostrobothnia Wellbeing Services County (Pohde)
healthAuthorities.description: CEO Ilkka Luoma. Esko (public/non-commercial, Esko Systems Oy) at OYS specialised care for decades; primary care migrating region-wide from fragmented legacy systems, full-coverage target during 2026.

healthAuthorities.name: Kainuu Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Leader Sami Mäenpää. Tietoevry Lifecare, region-wide since 2011.

healthAuthorities.name: Lapland Wellbeing Services County
healthAuthorities.description: Leader Jari Jokela. Runs TWO acute hospitals (Rovaniemi + Kemi, the latter the former separate Länsi-Pohja hospital district, merged in at the 2023 reform). Esko is the intended unification platform via the 'Tokka' project, but the region inherited roughly 300 separate legacy patient-record systems at the 2023 reform and full unification is projected to take ~10 years — NOT a single system today.

healthAuthorities.name: Åland (Ålands hälso- och sjukvård, ÅHS)
healthAuthorities.description: Director Erica Bonns (from 25 May 2026). Autonomous, self-governing region entirely outside the mainland wellbeing-county reform. Cambio COSMIC (awarded 21 May 2024) as the single clinical-journal system across all public healthcare on Åland, plus UNA Oy 'Blankett'/'Samtycke' Swedish-language modules (launched 28 Sep 2025) on top.

procurementNotices.title: Southwest Finland (Varha) CGI OMNI360 patient information system award
procurementNotices.notes: Replaces legacy Uranus. Full go-live for Tyks (specialised care) targeted December 2026; primary/dental care already live. Run jointly/in parallel with Pirkanmaa and North Savo, who separately procured OMNI360 from CGI around the same time.

procurementNotices.title: Pirkanmaa and North Savo joint CGI OMNI360 patient information system award
procurementNotices.notes: Joint tender run via shared ICT company Istekki. Each region gets its own separate OMNI360 instance. Pirkanmaa: ~19,000 employees, 500,000+ residents; North Savo: ~12,500 employees, ~250,000 residents. Retires legacy Lifecare + Mediatri (Pirkanmaa). Primary care live in both regions; specialised-care (Tays, KYS) go-live delayed.

procurementNotices.title: Central Uusimaa (Keusote) CGI OMNI360 client and patient information system award
procurementNotices.notes: ~EUR 10m. Consolidates separate municipal systems across Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Mäntsälä, Nurmijärvi, Pornainen, Tuusula; includes WinHIT module for dental care. Selected instead of an originally planned Apotti go-live in Tuusula ('Tuusulan Apotti-käyttöönotosta luovutaan').

procurementNotices.title: Western Uusimaa and Eastern Uusimaa joint Tietoevry Lifecare award
procurementNotices.notes: Joint procurement: Tietoevry Finland Oy primary bidder (100/100 evaluation score), CGI Suomi Oy backup (86.71). Western Uusimaa contract ~EUR 11.3m ex-VAT; Eastern Uusimaa ~EUR 4.3m ex-VAT (implementation + 4 years operations); combined estimate shown here. Both counties formally exited Apotti 2 May 2024 (Western ~EUR 17m exit cost, Eastern ~EUR 5m).

procurementNotices.title: Ostrobothnia (Pohjanmaa) Tietoevry Lifecare award
procurementNotices.notes: Selected via competitive dialogue against CGI and Mediconsult; 140 clinical staff took part in product evaluation, Lifecare ranked first in 6 of 7 categories. Governance approvals 19 Jun and 4 Sep 2023. Consolidates 6 legacy patient/client information systems. Go-live began 6 Oct 2024 (Kristiinankaupunki, Kaskinen), region-wide by spring 2025.

procurementNotices.title: North Karelia and South Savo joint Tietoevry Lifecare client/patient information system award
procurementNotices.notes: South Savo already ran the Lifecare patient system; this decision added the Lifecare client/social-care system for both counties. North Karelia's implementation is NOT YET LIVE: phased rollout social services Nov 2026, dental spring 2027, primary/home-care/specialised-care autumn 2027, full completion end 2027.

procurementNotices.title: Central Finland northern sub-region Tietoevry Lifecare extension award
procurementNotices.notes: Selected over CGI and Mediconsult; decision binding from 1 Feb 2024 after the appeal period. Extends the already-live Lifecare platform to a 9-municipality northern sub-region (Karstula, Kannonkoski, Kinnula, Kivijärvi, Kyyjärvi, Pihtipudas, Saarijärvi, Viitasaari, Äänekoski), replacing Pegasos, Mediatri and WinHit. Planned go-live autumn 2024.

procurementNotices.title: Kymenlaakso first-in-Finland Lifecare version upgrade
procurementNotices.notes: Kymenlaakso became the first Finnish wellbeing county to roll out the newest Lifecare version, 24 Sep 2023, supporting a productivity programme from summer 2023 (IT Director Matti Ahola).

procurementNotices.title: Åland (ÅHS) Cambio COSMIC main clinical-journal system award
procurementNotices.notes: Single clinical-journal system ('huvudjournalsystemet') for all public healthcare on Åland. Implementation and staff training began immediately after award.

procurementNotices.title: Central Uusimaa, Western Uusimaa and Eastern Uusimaa formal exit from Oy Apotti Ab ownership
procurementNotices.notes: Three of the original Uusimaa wellbeing counties formally exited Apotti ownership, announced 2 May 2024. Exit costs: Central Uusimaa (Keusote) ~EUR 11m, Western Uusimaa ~EUR 17m, Eastern Uusimaa ~EUR 5m (combined ~EUR 33m shown here). HUS Group, Helsinki and Vantaa & Kerava remain the three owners of Oy Apotti Ab (46.33% / 38.35% / 15.32%).
